h1: The 8 Best Craftsman Leaf Blowers of 2026, Ranked & Reviewed
metaTitle: Best Craftsman Leaf Blowers: Ranked & Reviewed
metaDescription: Ranked and reviewed by Primea: 8 leaf blowers from Craftsman V20 to DEWALT and Husqvarna, compared on airflow, speed settings, weight and kit contents.
summary: The CRAFTSMAN V20 brushless blower with battery and charger is the best pick for most yards: 410 CFM and a brushless motor. If you want more force, the DEWALT 60V lists 600 CFM. For small jobs, the V20 axial kit gives two speeds and a scraper. The cheapest Craftsman listings are weak at 200 CFM, so they suit patios only.
intro: Craftsman sells a family of V20 battery blowers that look nearly identical on a shelf and perform quite differently. The difference is in airflow, whether the kit includes a battery, and whether the motor is brushless, none of which is obvious from a product photo.

We reviewed eight blowers, six of them Craftsman, plus two outside picks from DEWALT and Husqvarna for context. Each was ranked on airflow, speed controls, weight claims and kit contents. We note when the listing is silent on a spec, and we do not fill gaps with guesses.

products.name: CRAFTSMAN Leaf Blower Cordless with Battery and Charger V20 RP
products.verdict: 410 CFM, a brushless motor and a battery and charger in the box. The sensible default.
products.description:
The V20 RP lists 410 CFM, a brushless motor for better runtime and force, and a battery and charger in the box. The brand claims 50 percent less noise and 39 percent less weight than gas blowers.

It wins because it is the strongest Craftsman here and arrives ready to use. Compared with the axial kit it moves more air, and against the 200 CFM models it is far stronger.

Buy it for a typical suburban yard. The noise and weight figures are the brand's claims.
pros: Battery and charger in the box
Less noise than gas per the brand
cons: Noise and weight claims are the brand's
Costs more than the cheaper V20 models
products.idealFor: Suburban yards with ordinary leaf fall.

products.name: Dewalt Blower AXIAL HNDHLD 60V 600CFM DCBL772B
products.verdict: 600 CFM from a 60V handheld, the strongest battery blower here. Bare tool.
products.description:
The DEWALT DCBL772B is a 60V axial handheld that lists 600 CFM, beating several battery blowers in this group. It is sold as a bare tool.

It ranks second because you need to supply a 60V battery, which is the expensive part. Against the Craftsman V20 RP it moves 190 more CFM.

Buy it if you already own DEWALT 60V batteries. Otherwise the cost climbs fast.
pros: 600 CFM, highest here among battery tools
products.skipIf: You are starting from scratch on a budget.

products.name: CRAFTSMAN V20 Cordless Axial Leaf Blower Kit
products.verdict: 380 CFM with a dual-speed trigger and an integrated scraper. Light and compact.
products.description:
The V20 axial kit lists 380 CFM, a two-stage trigger that lets you ease off near beds and open up on open ground, an integrated scraper to loosen stubborn debris and a lightweight, compact body.

It ranks third because it moves 30 CFM less than the V20 RP. It undercuts it on cost, and the scraper is a handy touch.

A good fit for small to mid-size yards. Pick the RP for a bigger lawn.

products.name: CRAFTSMAN V20 Cordless Leaf Blower (3-Speed)
products.verdict: A 3-speed selector with a lock-on trigger and three attachments included.
products.description:
This V20 has a 3-speed selector with a lock-on trigger, three included attachments for extra applications and a compact design that eases prolonged one-handed use. The listing shows no CFM figure.

It ranks fourth because the airflow is not stated. It costs less than the RP and gives more attachments than any other Craftsman here.

A good all-rounder for small jobs. Ask for the CFM before buying.
products.skipIf: You want a stated airflow figure.

products.name: CRAFTSMAN 20V MAX Cordless Leaf Blower with Battery and Charger
products.verdict: A 200 CFM starter kit with a battery and charger and a nozzle scraper.
products.description:
The 20V MAX lists 200 CFM, includes a battery and charger, and has an integrated nozzle scraper for stubborn debris. It is designed to maneuver in tight spaces.

It ranks fifth because 200 CFM is half of the RP's. It is a ready kit, which the cheaper V20 listing is not guaranteed to be.

A fit for patios and small yards. Not for large lawns.
products.skipIf: You have a lawn full of leaves.

products.name: CRAFTSMAN V20 Cordless Leaf Blower (200 CFM)
products.verdict: The least expensive pick here, with 200 CFM, a scraper and a wall-storage hook.
products.description:
This V20 lists 200 CFM, an integrated scraper and an integrated hook for VERSATRACK wall storage, at the lowest price in the roundup.

It ranks sixth because it has the same 200 CFM as the 20V MAX kit but may not include a battery. It is the cheapest way into the Craftsman line.

Buy it if you already own V20 batteries. Check the box contents.
products.skipIf: You need a battery in the box.

products.name: DEWALT 20V MAX Blower
products.verdict: A DEWALT 20V MAX with a trigger lock-on and three nozzles. Only 100 CFM.
products.description:
The DEWALT 20V MAX blower lists 100 CFM, a trigger lock-on that reduces hand fatigue and three included nozzle attachments.

It ranks seventh because 100 CFM is the lowest in the group. It does fit the broad DEWALT 20V battery line.

Buy it for sweeping a deck or workshop. It will not move a yard of leaves.
products.skipIf: You need to clear lawn leaves.

products.name: Husqvarna 125B Gas Leaf Blower
products.verdict: A 470 CFM gas handheld with an ergonomic design. The only gas pick here.
products.description:
The Husqvarna 125B is a gas handheld that lists 470 CFM, an ergonomic design for extended use and a high-powered gas engine for regular lawn care.

It ranks last in a Craftsman guide because it is a different kind of tool: gas, noisy and heavier than a V20. Against the V20 RP it moves more air.

Buy it if you prefer gas for a mid-size lawn. Everyone else should stay with battery.
products.idealFor: Gas fans with a mid-size lawn.

whatMatters.detail: Craftsman V20 blowers range from 200 to 410 CFM. A 200 CFM tool suits patios and decks, while 380 to 410 handles lawns. Look for the CFM figure on the listing, and be careful when it is missing.
Many listings sell a bare tool with a battery and charger sold separately. A kit costs more but is usually cheaper than buying the pieces. Read the contents list before ordering.
A brushless motor is more efficient, giving better runtime and force from the same battery. The V20 RP lists one. Check the listing for the word brushless.
A dual-speed or 3-speed selector lets you drop power near flower beds and boost it for wet leaves. A lock-on trigger saves your finger on long jobs. Check the controls before buying.
Figures like 50 percent less noise or 39 percent less weight than gas come from the brand. Use them as a direction, not a measurement, and compare CFM and weight where they are listed.

faq.q: Which Craftsman leaf blower is the strongest?
faq.a: The V20 RP lists 410 CFM, the top figure among Craftsman models here.

faq.q: Do Craftsman blowers include a battery?
faq.a: Some do. The V20 RP and the 20V MAX kit include a battery and charger. Check each listing.
For decks and patios, yes. For a lawn of leaves, choose 380 CFM or more.
If you own 60V batteries, yes: it lists 600 CFM. Otherwise the battery cost is high.

faq.q: Are the brand's noise claims reliable?
faq.a: They are manufacturer statements. We have not verified them.

faq.q: Should I buy a gas blower instead?
faq.a: Only if you dislike charging. The Husqvarna 125B lists 470 CFM but needs fuel and upkeep.

finalTake: For most yards the CRAFTSMAN V20 RP with battery and charger is the right answer: 410 CFM and a brushless motor. If you want more force, the DEWALT 60V 600 CFM is the strongest here. For small jobs, the V20 axial kit has two speeds and a scraper. The 200 CFM listings suit patios only.
